feedTitle: Isle of Man 5 day shipping forecast

items.title: 5 day shipping forecast updated as of 11 May 2026 6:17am
items.description:
##Today##


##Warnings)##

Strong winds at first.


##Wind)##

NW 5 occasionally 6, soon veering NE 4 or 5 this morning and then decreasing North or NE 3 or 4 later in the morning. Backing North or NW 3 or 4 in afternoon, occasionally 5 around north of island, then backing West tonight and increasing 4 or 5 in all waters.


##State of sea)##

Slight or moderate, falling slight for a time later today.


##Weather)##

Showery outbreaks of rain soon clearing, then fair before patchy light rain and drizzle later tonight.


##Visibility)##

Good, occasionally moderate in showery rain at first and rain and drizzle later.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 7°C and max. air temperature 12°C
##Sea Temperature##

10°C
##Tomorrow##


##Warnings)##

Strong winds.


##Wind)##

West or NW 4 or 5, increasing 5 or 6 in morning, then decreasing 4 or 5 again during afternoon. Increasing West or NW 5 or 6 overnight.


##State of sea)##

Slight or moderate.


##Weather)##

Patchy light rain and drizzle soon clearing to scattered showers, then more frequent showers later.


##Visibility)##

Good, falling moderate in rain and drizzle at first and in showers.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 9°C and max. air temperature 13°C
##Sea Temperature##

10°C
##Wednesday, 13 May 2026##


##Warnings)##

Strong winds.


##Wind)##

NW 5 or 6, increasing 6 occasionally 7 for a time, then veering North or NW 5 or 6 later in day/ overnight.


##State of sea)##

Mainly moderate, but moderate or rough for a time.


##Weather)##

Scattered showers.


##Visibility)##

Mostly good, possibly moderate in showers.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 7°C and max. air temperature 12°C
##Sea Temperature##

10°C

##Warnings)##

##Wind)##

##State of sea)##

##Weather)##

Isolated showers.


##Visibility)##

Good.


##Temperature##

10°C
